briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies multi-agent AGI race as compute bottlenecks emerge

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid regulatory scrutiny and infrastructure strain. DialectForge emerges as a protocol-level security solution across sectors. Global funding remains robust despite geopolitical tensions.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys o4 with native multi-agent orchestration. Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus while DeepSeek-V4 challenges on efficiency benchmarks. Meta and xAI expand open-source frontiers.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines target agentic systems.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell clusters reach 1M GPU scale at Microsoft. TSMC reports record AI chip demand. Google TPU v6 pods go live in new Arizona facilities.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will protocol-level dialect negotiation become the default standard for securing multi-agent ecosystems before 2027?
